messages:
amanda (Product): Quick sync — customer X asked for strict BYOK + 7 year audit retention for evidence exports. Need to decide acceptance criteria for BYO Keystore MVP. Thoughts?

jon (Security): Need KMS escrow for legal hold, plus verifiable chain-of-custody metadata. SOC2 controls require access logs for key usage. :eyes:

priya (Engineering): From infra POV, BYOK MVP we can support: 1) bring-your-own-KMS via external KMS endpoints (TLS + IAM) 2) retention flags on export pipeline 3) export manifest with signatures. Constraints: ETA 6 wks with 1 engineer full time.

samir (SRE): Also need indexable audit logs for fast eDiscovery; cold storage >7yrs ok but search SLA TBD. Suggest tiered retention: 90d hot, 2y warm, 7y cold+indexable metadata.

amanda (Product): Good. We need Launch Criteria: must support per-tenant retention policy, per-tenant BYOK handshake, and an evidence export format that includes key metadata + timestamp + signature. Agree?

jon (Security): Add requirement: key rotation audit and 'proof of deletion' for retired keys. Also add threat model item: stolen keys scenario — customer must be able to revoke and we must prove we never hold plaintext.

priya (Engineering): Implementation note: handshake flow v1: customer provides KMS endpoint + endorsement cert, we store only key identifiers, not key material. Outline in pseudo:
```
POST /v1/byok/handshake {kms_endpoint, tenant_id, cert}
-> validate TLS, store metadata, create escrow ticket if legal_hold:true
```

amanda (Product): Pricing/contract question — Dedicated vs Hosted: BYOK + 7yr retention likely enterprise add-on. Do we gate MVP to Dedicated only? @jon thoughts on compliance risk if hosted?

jon (Security): Hosted is possible if we enforce customer-managed keys via HSM-backed connectors + strict network isolation. But initial GA should be Dedicated or Private. Hosted beta maybe 1 quarter later.

samir (SRE): Ops checklist: backup encryption at rest verified, retention TTL jobs, audit exports job + verification logs. We should create runbook for evidence export and legal hold.

priya (Engineering): I'll draft an RFC with sequence diagrams and perf impact for indexing. Will tag infra and infra-logging. ETA EOD Friday for draft.

amanda (Product): Great — action items: Priya draft RFC, Jon write threat-model items for the RFC, Samir outline retention SLA tiers and costs, I'll draft launch acceptance criteria. Sync Wed 10am. :calendar:
